subject: História
description_pt: Selecionar, por meio da consulta de fontes de diferentes naturezas, e registrar acontecimentos ocorridos ao longo do tempo na cidade ou região em que vive.

components.description_pt: Consultar fontes de diferentes tipos para localizar eventos ocorridos em sua cidade ou região ao longo do tempo
components.description_en: Consult sources of different types to locate events that occurred in their city or region over time
components.cc_component_description: Conduct advanced searches to locate authoritative print and digital sources

components.description_pt: Selecionar eventos históricos relevantes relacionados à sua cidade ou região de múltiplas fontes
components.description_en: Select relevant historical events related to their city or region from multiple sources
components.cc_component_description: Gather relevant information from multiple sources to answer a research question

components.description_pt: Registrar eventos históricos selecionados de sua cidade ou região de forma organizada
components.description_en: Record selected historical events from their city or region in an organized manner
components.cc_component_description: Construct sequences of historical events and discuss their societal impacts collaboratively

cc_matches.description: Conduct short research projects to answer a question (including a self-generated question), drawing on several sources and generating additional related, focused questions that allow for multiple avenues of exploration.

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán interactuar con otros (personas y medios) sobre argumentos para...
* analizar información fundamentada con evidencia de múltiples fuentes
* debatir varias perspectivas
* intercambiar posturas y contra posturas con el uso de evidencia y razonamiento
* comparar la relevancia de fundamentos con las intenciones del autor
* formar secuencias de eventos y sus impactos en la sociedad
* criticar la credibilidad de evidencia

Gather relevant information from multiple authoritative print and digital sources, using advanced searches effectively; assess the usefulness of each source in answering the research question; integrate information into the text selectively to maintain the flow of ideas, avoiding plagiarism and following a standard format for citation.
